I got the FISP coupon again this year, so I will put one bag of NPK and one bag of urea on this main maize plot of mine. I am planting the same hybrid seed my uncle used last season because his yield was much better than the local variety. I do not have cattle, so there is no manure to spread, and I cannot afford chemicals for pests or spraying, so we will weed by hand like we always do. My brother and I will handle most of the work, but I will hire a couple of laborers for a day or two when the weeding is heavy and at harvest.
